tips.text: Cast Revenant's Enthrall or Nyx's Mind Control on the Prelate in phase 1 to send it straight to phase 2.
Bring an ammo-free weapon like a thrown Glaive, an Incarnon or a battery weapon; holding the lantern blocks your primary.
Run it solo; squadmates who carry the lantern off slow the fight down.
Farm on normal difficulty; Steel Path does not improve the drops and makes the boss much tankier.
Apply heat damage in bursts with a primer like Epitaph or Citrine; the boss loses its status each time it teleports.
Bring Volt to sprint between the Bastion and the boss, Xaku to pin it, or Loki or Ivara with strong melee for safe solo runs.
Use a large-area weapon like Kuva Bramma, Zarr or Ogris to clear the heal-linked Infested.
Expect about seven kills of 5 to 10 minutes each, so one or two sittings.
